With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: TaskStop
tools.description:
- Stops a running background task by its ID
- Takes a task_id parameter identifying the task to stop
- To stop an agent-team teammate, pass its agent ID or bare teammate name as task_id
- To stop a background agent spawned with a name, pass that name as task_id
- Returns a success or failure status
- Use this tool when you need to terminate a long-running task

task_id.description: The ID of the background task to stop. Agent-team teammates and named background agents are also accepted by agent ID or name.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: WebFetch
tools.description:
Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model.

- Fails on authenticated/private URLs — use an authenticated MCP tool or `gh` for those instead. claude.ai artifact links (claude.ai/artifact/{id} or claude.ai/code/artifact/{uuid}) are published artifacts: read them with the Artifact tool (action "read"), not WebFetch or curl.
- Fails on localhost and other hostnames without a dot; for a local server, use curl via Bash.
- HTTP is upgraded to HTTPS. Cross-host redirects are returned to you rather than followed; call again with the redirect URL.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

prompt.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content

offset.description: Character position in the page text to start reading from. Use it to read on through a page too long for one call, with the value the previous result gave.

tools.name: WebSearch
tools.description:
Search the web. Returns result blocks with titles and URLs. US-only.

- The current month is (provided in the conversation below) — use this when searching for recent information.
- `allowed_domains` / `blocked_domains` filter results.
- After answering from results, end with a "Sources:" list of the URLs you used as markdown links.

allowed_domains.description: Only include search results from these domains

blocked_domains.description: Never include search results from these domains

mode.description: "standard": the normal web search: quick and cheap; right for straightforward lookups (reference facts, official pages, documentation, well-known people, places and topics) and simple follow-up lookups. "extended": a thorough, fresh search at several times the cost and latency.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

Now launching O1a research: five parallel collectors (game groups, SaaS, icon conventions, criticised examples), each paired with an independent verifier that re-checks every screenshot.

input.script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'ikon-arastirmasi',
  description: 'Icon research: games + SaaS + conventions + criticised examples for 4 product modules, with screenshots and independent verification',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Topla', detail: '5 collectors, each a different modality, screenshots downloaded and viewed' },
    { title: 'Doğrula', detail: 'one skeptic per collector re-opens every screenshot and URL' },
  ],
}

const S = args.S
const IMG = S + '/research/img'

const CONTEXT = `
BAĞLAM (oku, tekrar araştırma): Project Unicorn, Godot'da TR/EN bir startup yönetim oyunu. Ürün penceresinin sprint ekranında sol
sütunda "MODÜLLER" listesi var. Her modülün bugünkü iki harfli kısaltması (ÇK, İK, EN, GÜ, BÜ, GE) yerine 24 px'lik bir kutuda 16 px'lik
DÜZ DOLGULU BEYAZ bir ikon gelecek; zemin koyu kömür rengi. Oyuncu modülü adını okumadan, ilk bakışta ikondan tanımalı.
Modüller ve oyunda neyi kapsadıkları:
- Çekirdek (Core): ürünün kendisi. ONAYLI ikon: küp. Araştırma dışı.
- Güven & Ölçek (Trust & Scale): güvenlik + dayanıklılık. ONAYLI ikon: kalkan. Araştırma dışı.
- İlk Kullanım ve Erişim (Onboarding & Access), B2B ve B2C: hatları "Mobil uygulama" ve "Yardım Merkezi" (help center); kullanıcının ürüne
  ilk girişi, ilk kullanım, erişim. REDDEDİLDİ: mezuniyet şapkası.
- Entegrasyonlar (Integrations), yalnız B2B (ERP yazılımı): API, webhook, başka araçlara bağlanma. REDDEDİLDİ: komut satırı penceresi (>_).
- Büyüme (Growth), yalnız B2C: kitle büyümesi, paylaşma, davet, edinim. REDDEDİLDİ: daire içinde yukarı ok.
- Gelir (Revenue), yalnız B2C: ücretli plan, abonelik, ödeme. REDDEDİLDİ: fiyat etiketi.

SORU: Bu dört kavram (onboarding, integrations, growth, revenue) için (a) yönetim/şirket/tycoon oyunları ve (b) gerçek SaaS panoları hangi
ikon metaforlarını kullanıyor? Hangileri okunuyor, hangileri okunmuyor ya da eleştiriliyor? Bu araştırma Erdem'in (oyunun sahibi) ikon
seçimini besler.

KURALLAR:
1. Kaynak = gerçek ekran görüntüsü. Her kaynak için en az bir görüntüyü indir ve Read aracıyla AÇIP BAK. Görüntü yoksa ya da ikon
   görüntüde seçilemiyorsa o kaynak sayılmaz. Metin özeti araştırma değildir. Uydurma yok; bulamazsan "bulunamadı" yaz.
2. İndirme: curl -sL -m 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o "${IMG}/<ID>_<kısa-ad>.<uzantı>" "<url>". Yalnız görüntü indir (jpg/png/webp/gif);
   indirdiğin hiçbir şeyi çalıştırma. 'file' ile türünü denetle (HTML gelirse sil). webp ya da gif ise
   'sips -s format png <dosya> --out <aynı ad>.png' ile PNG'ye çevir ve PNG'yi aç. Görüntünün boyutunu
   'sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight <dosya>' ile oku.
3. Steam mağaza görüntüleri: https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=<appid>&filters=screenshots (path_full 1920x1080).
   Steam yorumları: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/<appid>?json=1&filter=all&language=english&review_type=negative&num_per_page=100
   (yorum metninde "icon" geçenleri ara: curl ile al, python3 ile süz). Wiki, yapımcı sitesi, belge sayfası görüntüleri de olur.
4. Her kaynak için ikonun ve yanındaki etiketin bulunduğu bölgeyi orijinal görüntü pikseliyle ver (crop: x,y,w,h). Bölge ikonu ve
   etiketini içermeli; en az 120x60 px olsun ki 2x büyütünce okunsun. Bölgeyi doğrulamak için kırpıp bakabilirsin:
   'sips --cropToHeightWidth <h> <w> --cropOffset <y> <x> <dosya> --out <geçici.png>' sonra Read. (sips cropOffset önce y sonra x alır.)
5. Kaynak sicili: her kaynağa sana ayrılan bloktan bir ID (değişmez), URL, yayıncı, yayın tarihi (bilinmiyorsa "bilinmiyor"), erişim
   2026-10-28, güven (Yüksek: oyunun/ürünün kendi sayfası ya da belgesi, Steam'in kendi verisi, hakemli çalışma; Orta: tanınmış basın,
   yöntemini yazan analiz, wiki; Düşük: tek blog, forum anekdotu, satıcının kendini anlatması).

# The trust ledger forgives on its own, BEFORE the satisfaction drift, so this tick's target
	# already reflects the (slightly smaller) grudge — a broken promise makes an account
	# fragile for a month, not forever.
	if not is_zero_approx(c.trust_offset):
		CustomerRegistry.set_trust_offset(c.id, _forgiven_trust(c.trust_offset))
	_tick_satisfaction(c)
	# A delegated account raises ONE escalation when it sinks past the level its rep can hold;
	# recovery above the threshold re-arms it. The flag IS the edge: `customer.cs_escalation`
	# reads it through `musteri.cs_escalated` (and the `escalated` scope selector) in the daily
	# scan, and the gate decides.
	c.cs_escalated = c.assigned_to != "" and c.satisfaction < B2BConstants.CS_ESCALATION_SAT
	# EVERY account runs the risk machinery, delegated or not: the player hears from the rep
	# AND still owns the churn decision. A rep slows the erosion (cs_dampen, see
	# _tick_satisfaction) and the request channel absorbs routine noise; a genuine churn risk
	# is ALWAYS the founder's call. Exempting delegated accounts would let one Müşteri
	# Temsilcisi immunise a whole roster against churn — a feature that lets the player
	# permanently solve money.
	if c.satisfaction < c.tolerance:
		_tick_at_risk(c)
	else:
		_tick_healthy(c)


# --- Layer 1: visible satisfaction drifts toward a product-health target ---
static func _tick_satisfaction(c: Customer) -> void:
	var delta: int = _drift(c, satisfaction_target(c), GameState.day, c.satisfaction)
	if delta != 0:
		CustomerRegistry.set_satisfaction(c.id, c.satisfaction + delta)


## The satisfaction the player reads one tick from now if the trust ledger then holds `trust`: the
## ledger forgives first, then the drift walks toward the target as far as one tick lets it.
static func satisfaction_next_tick(c: Customer, trust: float) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	return c.satisfaction + _drift(c, _target_on(c, day, _forgiven_trust(trust)), day, c.satisfaction)


## The satisfaction a trust hit of `delta` leaves the account at, by the card's own share alone: where it stands now,
## moved by what the hit does to its TARGET (the target with the ledger at `trust_offset + delta` against the target with
## the ledger as it is, both on the same day), kept in 0..100. A target already at 0 or 100 (or a
## ledger already at its limit) takes less than `delta`, and the figure says so. The drift toward the target and the
## ledger's own forgiveness are not the card's and stay out, so the chip's "{v}", its arrow and this figure read the same.
static func satisfaction_with_trust(c: Customer, delta: int) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	var shift: int = _target_on(c, day, B2BConstants.clamp_trust(c.trust_offset + delta)) \
		- _target_on(c, day, c.trust_offset)
	return clampi(c.satisfaction + shift, 0, 100)


## The satisfaction the player reads one tick after a promise to this account breaks (on_promise_resolved "broken"):
## the drop lands at once, the trust ledger takes its hit and the bar rises, then the drift walks back toward the
## target (the onboarding floor stands on the raised bar).
static func satisfaction_after_break(c: Customer) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	var sat: int = clampi(c.satisfaction + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT, 0, 100)
	var trust: float = B2BConstants.clamp_trust(c.trust_offset + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET)
	return sat + _drift(c, _target_on(c, day, _forgiven_trust(trust), _tolerance_after_break(c)), day, sat)


## The bar a broken word leaves the account at: pickier, but never more than PROMISE_TOLERANCE_CEILING over where
## it was seeded.
static func _tolerance_after_break(c: Customer) -> int:
	return mini(c.tolerance + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_TOLERANCE,
		B2BConstants.seed_tolerance(c.scale, c.industry) + B2BConstants.PROMISE_TOLERANCE_CEILING)


## How far satisfaction, standing at `sat`, moves toward `target` on tick `day`.
static func _drift(c: Customer, target: int, day: int, sat: int) -> int:
	var step: int = B2BConstants.SAT_DRIFT_STEP
	# Onboarding window (first ONBOARDING_WEEKS after signing): first impressions
	# swing harder — a bug-heavy product at signing bites more, a solid one wins faster.
	if day < c.onboarding_until:
		step = int(ceil(float(step) * B2BConstants.ONBOARDING_AMP))
	var gap: int = target - sat
	var down: int = step
	# İLGİLENİLEN HESAP DAHA YAVAŞ AŞINIR, ve "ilgilenen" hesabın SAHİBİDİR (bkz.
	# _account_owner): kurucunun kendi masasındaki hesap da aynı formülle korunur, özel kural yok.
	# Bonus ETKİN ÇIKTIDAN okunur, ham eksenden değil: `HRSystem.effective_skill` alan
	# katsayısını, odağı (iki iş = 0,50), moral payını ve huy çarpanlarını uyguluyor.
	# YALNIZ AŞAĞI YÖNDE: yukarı toparlanma tam güçte kalır.
	#
	# DESIGN-PARKED: the erosion MULTIPLIER is the working shape for the care bonus. The named
	# alternative is widening the account's tolerance instead — a different feel (the account
	# forgives more rather than souring slower) and a different interaction with §5.2's loss
	# reasons, so it is the director's call.
	if gap < 0:
		var owner: Character = _account_owner(c)
		if owner != null:
			var output: float = HRSystem.effective_skill(owner, HRConstants.AREA_CUSTOMER_SUCCESS)
			down = int(float(down) * B2BConstants.cs_dampen(int(round(output))))
			# HAYIR DİYEMEZ: kendi hesaplarında memnuniyet daha yüksek durur. Bir DELTA
			# ÜRETMİYOR — var olan aşınmayı daha da yumuşatıyor, yani "oynanmamış
			# ekonomik sonuç yok" kuralı duruyor: düşüşün sebebi hep ürün sağlığı.
			var bonus: float = HRConstants.trait_sum(owner.traits, "satisfaction_bonus")
			if bonus > 0.0:
				down = int(float(down) * maxf(0.0, 1.0 - bonus / 100.0))
	# Both steps are per-day caps, the care dampener applied per day; the tick moves seven days
	# of them and stops at the target.
	return clampi(gap, -int(TimeModel.per_tick(down)), int(TimeModel.per_tick(step)))


## WHO LOOKS AFTER THIS ACCOUNT. A named rep, or the founder when nobody is named:
## `assigned_to == ""` means "on the founder's own desk", never "nobody" (`assign_customer`'s
## own contract says so).
##
## AN ABSENT OWNER CARES FOR NOBODY: an on-leave or in-training rep dampens nothing, and the
## account erodes at full strength while they are away (Ekip §8.6). `null` is that answer.
static func _account_owner(c: Customer) -> Character:
	var owner: Character = CharacterRegistry.get_founder() if c.assigned_to == "" \
		else CharacterRegistry.get_character(c.assigned_to)
	if owner == null or owner.status != HRConstants.STATUS_ACTIVE:
		return null
	return owner

# The trust ledger forgives on its own, BEFORE the satisfaction drift, so this tick's target
	# already reflects the (slightly smaller) grudge — a broken promise makes an account
	# fragile for a month, not forever.
	if not is_zero_approx(c.trust_offset):

	_tick_satisfaction(c)
	# A delegated account raises ONE escalation when it sinks past the level its rep can hold;
	# recovery above the threshold re-arms it. The flag IS the edge: `customer.cs_escalation`
	# reads it through `musteri.cs_escalated` (and the `escalated` scope selector) in the daily
	# scan, and the gate decides.
	c.cs_escalated = c.assigned_to != "" and c.satisfaction < B2BConstants.CS_ESCALATION_SAT
	# EVERY account runs the risk machinery, delegated or not: the player hears from the rep
	# AND still owns the churn decision. A rep slows the erosion (cs_dampen, see
	# _tick_satisfaction) and the request channel absorbs routine noise; a genuine churn risk
	# is ALWAYS the founder's call. Exempting delegated accounts would let one Müşteri
	# Temsilcisi immunise a whole roster against churn — a feature that lets the player
	# permanently solve money.
	if c.satisfaction < c.tolerance:
		_tick_at_risk(c)
	else:
		_tick_healthy(c)


# --- Layer 1: visible satisfaction drifts toward a product-health target ---
static func _tick_satisfaction(c: Customer) -> void:
	var delta: int = _drift(c, satisfaction_target(c), GameState.day, c.satisfaction)
	if delta != 0:
		CustomerRegistry.set_satisfaction(c.id, c.satisfaction + delta)


## The satisfaction the player reads one tick from now if the trust ledger then holds `trust`: the
## ledger forgives first, then the drift walks toward the target as far as one tick lets it.
static func satisfaction_next_tick(c: Customer, trust: float) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	return c.satisfaction + _drift(c, _target_on(c, day, _forgiven_trust(trust)), day, c.satisfaction)


## The satisfaction a trust hit of `delta` leaves the account at, by the card's own share alone: where it stands now,
## moved by what the hit does to its TARGET (the target with the ledger at `trust_offset + delta` against the target with
## the ledger as it is, both on the same day), kept in 0..100. A target already at 0 or 100 (or a
## ledger already at its limit) takes less than `delta`, and the figure says so. The drift toward the target and the
## ledger's own forgiveness are not the card's and stay out, so the chip's "{v}", its arrow and this figure read the same.
static func satisfaction_with_trust(c: Customer, delta: int) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	var shift: int = _target_on(c, day, B2BConstants.clamp_trust(c.trust_offset + delta)) \
		- _target_on(c, day, c.trust_offset)
	return clampi(c.satisfaction + shift, 0, 100)


## The satisfaction the player reads one tick after a promise to this account breaks (on_promise_resolved "broken"):
## the drop lands at once, the trust ledger takes its hit and the bar rises, then the drift walks back toward the
## target (the onboarding floor stands on the raised bar).
static func satisfaction_after_break(c: Customer) -> int:
	var day: int = GameState.day + 1
	var sat: int = clampi(c.satisfaction + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT, 0, 100)
	var trust: float = B2BConstants.clamp_trust(c.trust_offset + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET)
	return sat + _drift(c, _target_on(c, day, _forgiven_trust(trust), _tolerance_after_break(c)), day, sat)


## The bar a broken word leaves the account at: pickier, but never more than PROMISE_TOLERANCE_CEILING over where
## it was seeded.
static func _tolerance_after_break(c: Customer) -> int:
	return mini(c.tolerance + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_TOLERANCE,
		B2BConstants.seed_tolerance(c.scale, c.industry) + B2BConstants.PROMISE_TOLERANCE_CEILING)


## How far satisfaction, standing at `sat`, moves toward `target` on tick `day`.
static func _drift(c: Customer, target: int, day: int, sat: int) -> int:
	var step: int = B2BConstants.SAT_DRIFT_STEP
	# Onboarding window (first ONBOARDING_WEEKS after signing): first impressions
	# swing harder — a bug-heavy product at signing bites more, a solid one wins faster.
	if day < c.onboarding_until:
		step = int(ceil(float(step) * B2BConstants.ONBOARDING_AMP))
	var gap: int = target - sat
	var down: int = step
	# İLGİLENİLEN HESAP DAHA YAVAŞ AŞINIR, ve "ilgilenen" hesabın SAHİBİDİR (bkz.
	# _account_owner): kurucunun kendi masasındaki hesap da aynı formülle korunur, özel kural yok.
	# Bonus ETKİN ÇIKTIDAN okunur, ham eksenden değil: `HRSystem.effective_skill` alan
	# katsayısını, odağı (iki iş = 0,50), moral payını ve huy çarpanlarını uyguluyor.
	# YALNIZ AŞAĞI YÖNDE: yukarı toparlanma tam güçte kalır.
	#
	# DESIGN-PARKED: the erosion MULTIPLIER is the working shape for the care bonus. The named
	# alternative is widening the account's tolerance instead — a different feel (the account
	# forgives more rather than souring slower) and a different interaction with §5.2's loss
	# reasons, so it is the director's call.
	if gap < 0:
		var owner: Character = _account_owner(c)
		if owner != null:
			var output: float = HRSystem.effective_skill(owner, HRConstants.AREA_CUSTOMER_SUCCESS)
			down = int(float(down) * B2BConstants.cs_dampen(int(round(output))))
			# HAYIR DİYEMEZ: kendi hesaplarında memnuniyet daha yüksek durur. Bir DELTA
			# ÜRETMİYOR — var olan aşınmayı daha da yumuşatıyor, yani "oynanmamış
			# ekonomik sonuç yok" kuralı duruyor: düşüşün sebebi hep ürün sağlığı.
			var bonus: float = HRConstants.trait_sum(owner.traits, "satisfaction_bonus")
			if bonus > 0.0:

	# of them and stops at the target.
	return clampi(gap, -int(TimeModel.per_tick(down)), int(TimeModel.per_tick(step)))

18240:static func _case_event_trust_delta_lasting() -> String:
	return ""


## B2 · A trust hit LASTS and its chip names the card's own share: the hit goes on the trust ledger and moves the
## account's target by exactly the hit, so the chip's "to" is "from" plus the hit (B2BSalesSystem.satisfaction_with_trust),
## kept in 0..100 and with the drift and the ledger's forgiveness (2.8 a tick) left out; the player still reads the dip a
## tick later (the ledger forgives, satisfaction walks toward its target at most 21 a tick). A standing cost
## (`per_sprint`) is charged at every sprint close until its line is clear or its step is live, and not on the close that
## clears it.
## FALSIFICATION: make EvEffects.trust_plan's "to" the next tick's reading (B2BSalesSystem.satisfaction_next_tick) or write
## the hit with set_satisfaction instead of the ledger and the first loop fails; drop the charge from SprintSystem._close
## and the sprint check fails; test the line before the close clears it and the last check fails.
static func _case_event_trust_delta_lasting() -> String:
	GameState.set_flag("mvp_sub_product_type_id", "ai_vector_search")
	_seed_b2b(1000)
	var c: Customer = CustomerRegistry.get_customer("co_lead_smoke")
	_past_onboarding(c)
	c.onboarding_until = GameState.day
	var ctx: Dictionary = _ctx_customer(c)
	# What a player reads one tick on, by the size of the hit: -6 and -8 show, -3 is forgiven away.
	for dip in [[-6, 3, 4], [-8, 5, 6], [-3, 0, 1]]:
		var delta: int = dip[0]
		CustomerRegistry.set_trust_offset(c.id, 0.0)
		CustomerRegistry.set_satisfaction(c.id, B2BSalesSystem.satisfaction_target(c))
		var from: int = c.satisfaction
		var hit: Dictionary = {"verb": "trust_delta", "amount": delta, "scope": "customer"}
		var shown: String = EvChips.text(EvChips.describe(hit, ctx, {}, false)[0])
		var row: Dictionary = EvEffects.run_played([hit], ctx)[0]
		var kept: String = EvChips.text(EvChips.describe(row, ctx, {}, true)[0])
		var to: int = int(row.accounts[0].to)
		if shown != kept or int(row.accounts[0].from) != from:
			return "%d: the card showed '%s', its history row reads '%s' (from %d)" % [delta, shown, kept, from]
		if to != clampi(from + delta, 0, 100) or not shown.contains("%d → %d" % [from, to]):
			return "%d: the chip '%s' does not name the card's own share %d → %d" % [delta, shown, from, clampi(from + delta, 0, 100)]
		GameState.advance_day()
		B2BSalesSystem.daily_tick()
		var held: float = move_toward(float(delta), 0.0, TimeModel.per_tick(B2BConstants.TRUST_OFFSET_DECAY_PER_DAY))
		if not is_equal_approx(c.trust_offset, held):
			return "%d: the ledger holds %f a tick later, want %f" % [delta, c.trust_offset, held]
		if from - c.satisfaction < int(dip[1]) or from - c.satisfaction > int(dip[2]):
			return "%d: the player sees %d → %d a tick later, want a dip of %d to %d" % [delta, from, c.satisfaction, dip[1], dip[2]]
	return _trust_standing_cost()


## The standing half of `_case_event_trust_delta_lasting`, through real sprint closes.
static func _trust_standing_cost() -> String:
	CustomerRegistry.remove("co_lead_smoke")
	_seed_sprint_live("erp")
	var line := "line_erp_ledger"
	var acct: Customer = _add_customer("co_trust", "Firm Trust")
	acct.industry = "retail"
	acct.seats = 50
	acct.mrr = 2000
	# A step ends it when it is live; a save keeps it meanwhile.
	B2BSalesSystem.add_trust_drain([acct.id], -3, {"step_live": "fixture_step"})
	if not SaveManager.save_to_slot(SAVE_SLOT_A):
		return "save_to_slot refused"
	var saved: Dictionary = SaveManager.read_slot(SAVE_SLOT_A)

# Dizüstü (Mac, M1, 8 GB) ortak değişkenleri ve Godot koşucusu. Kullanım:
#   S=<oturumun scratchpad'i>; ETIKET=URUN_ARAYUZU   # ya da OLAYLAR; ayrı satırda, öne ek olarak değil
#   . "<repo>/project-unicorn/docs/tasks/dizustu/mac_env.sh"
# Windows'taki APPDATA yalıtımının karşılığı HOME'dur: her Godot süreci kendi HOME'unu alır ve user:// oraya iner
# (<HOME>/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Project Unicorn/). Erdem'in gerçek HOME'una hiçbir koşu yazmaz.
: "${S:?S (scratchpad) yok}" "${ETIKET:?ETIKET yok}"
R="/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/Project Unicorn"
K="/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/.kilit"
GODOT=/Users/tugbauysal/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/coreutils/libexec/gnubin:$PATH"   # smoke_run.sh GNU timeout ister
GODOT_MAX=2      # bellek baskısı normalken makinede aynı anda en çok bu kadar Godot süreci (MCP'nin oyunu dahil)
FREE_MIN_MB=1000 # macOS'ta boş + etkin olmayan sayfalar; baskı düzeyiyle birlikte okunur

free_mb() {
  vm_stat | awk '/page size of/ {ps=$8} /Pages (free|inactive|speculative)/ {gsub("\\.","",$NF); p+=$NF} END {print int(p*ps/1048576)}'
}
# macOS bellek baskısı: 1 normal, 2 uyarı, 4 kritik. Kritikte yeni Godot yok; uyarıda makinede tek Godot.
pressure() { sysctl -n kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level 2>/dev/null || echo 1; }
mem_ok() { local f; f=$(free_mb); [ "${f:-0}" -ge "$FREE_MIN_MB" ] && [ "$(pressure)" -lt 4 ] || { echo "STOP free=${f}MB pressure=$(pressure)"; return 1; }; }
godot_cap() { [ "$(pressure)" -ge 2 ] && echo 1 || echo "$GODOT_MAX"; }
# Süreç adıyla sayılır: komut satırında Godot yolu geçen kabuklar sayılmaz.
godots() { pgrep -x Godot | wc -l | tr -d ' '; }
lock_take() { mkdir -p "$K" && mkdir "$K/$1" 2>/dev/null && echo "$ETIKET $2 $(date +%FT%T) pid=$$" > "$K/$1/sahip"; }
lock_drop() { rm "$K/$1/sahip" && rmdir "$K/$1"; }
# Bir koşunun user:// klasörü: udir <ad>
udir() { echo "$S/home_$1/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Project Unicorn"; }
# Godot koşusu: gd <ad> <ağaç/project-unicorn> <args...>
# 99 sessiz kilidi başkasında, 98 bellek az, 97 makinede GODOT_MAX süreç koşuyor; üçünde de bekle ve yeniden dene.
gd() {
  local ad="$1" tree="$2"; shift 2
  if [ -d "$K/sessiz" ] && ! grep -q "^$ETIKET" "$K/sessiz/sahip" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WAIT sessiz: $(cat "$K/sessiz/sahip" 2>/dev/null)"; return 99; fi
  mem_ok || return 98
  [ "$(godots)" -lt "$(godot_cap)" ] || { echo "WAIT godot=$(godots) cap=$(godot_cap)"; return 97; }
  mkdir -p "$S/home_$ad"
  ( cd "$tree" && HOME="$S/home_$ad" "$GODOT" "$@" )
}
# Bekleyen sürüm: 97/98/99'da 20 saniyede bir yeniden dener (xargs işçileri ve betikler bunu kullanır; Godot'yu doğrudan

content.text: Now writing the converter. It outlines Lucide strokes as full-opacity fill, fills closed shapes at 0.4, and writes polygonised paths in the same format as the set.

input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/dd6f551f-9a19-44bf-832b-23c38bb6b809/scratchpad; cat > "$S/ikon/tools/fill.py" <<'EOF'
# Lucide (stroke) -> the set's flat two-layer style: strokes outlined as a full-opacity fill, closed shapes filled at 0.4.
# Usage: fill.py <in.svg> <out.svg> [stroke width, default 2.2] [mode: two|solid]
#   two:   outline full, closed interiors 0.4 (the set's two-layer look, e.g. util/exit.svg)
#   solid: closed interiors full too (strokes and interiors one shape)
import sys
from svgelements import SVG, Shape, Path, Move, Close, Line
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon
from shapely.ops import unary_union

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
sw = float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 2.2
mode = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 'two'
svg = SVG.parse(src)
strokes, fills = [], []
for el in svg.elements():
    if not isinstance(el, Shape) or isinstance(el, SVG):
        continue
    p = Path(el)
    for sub in p.as_subpaths():
        pts, closed = [], False
        for seg in sub:
            if isinstance(seg, Move):
                pts.append((seg.end.x, seg.end.y)); continue
            if isinstance(seg, Close):
                closed = True; continue
            n = 1 if isinstance(seg, Line) else 24
            for i in range(1, n + 1):
                q = seg.point(i / n)
                pts.append((q.x, q.y))
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        if not closed and len(pts) > 2 and abs(pts[0][0] - pts[-1][0]) < 1e-3 and abs(pts[0][1] - pts[-1][1]) < 1e-3:
            closed = True
        line = LineString(pts + ([pts[0]] if closed else []))
        strokes.append(line.buffer(sw / 2, cap_style=1, join_style=1, quad_segs=6))
        if closed and len(pts) >= 3:
            poly = Polygon(pts).buffer(0)
            if poly.area > 0.5:
                fills.append(poly)
stroke = unary_union(strokes)
fill = unary_union(fills) if fills else None
if mode == 'solid' and fill is not None:
    stroke = unary_union([stroke, fill]); fill = None
elif fill is not None:
    fill = fill.difference(stroke)

def d_of(geom):
    if geom is None or geom.is_empty:
        return ''
    polys = [geom] if isinstance(geom, Polygon) else [g for g in getattr(geom, 'geoms', []) if isinstance(g, Polygon)]
    out = []
    for poly in polys:
        poly = poly.simplify(0.02)
        for ring in [poly.exterior, *poly.interiors]:
            c = list(ring.coords)[:-1]
            out.append('M' + ' L'.join('%g %g' % (round(x, 2), round(y, 2)) for x, y in c) + ' Z')
    return ' '.join(out)

parts = ['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24">']
fd = d_of(fill)
if fd:
    parts.append('<path fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.4" fill-rule="evenodd" d="%s"/>' % fd)
parts.append('<path fill="#FFFFFF" fill-rule="evenodd" d="%s"/>' % d_of(stroke))
parts.append('</svg>')
open(dst, 'w').write('\n'.join(parts) + '\n')
EOF

## Talep satırı: müşteri ve söz tarihi, altında modülün işareti ve kartın adı; tıklanınca modülü açılır. Kartı bu sprintin planındaki
## talep zeminsiz ve soluktur, çipinde tik ve tarih durur.
func _request_row(r: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var planned: bool = r.planned
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	row.theme_type_variation = &"RequestRowPlanned" if planned else &"RequestRow"
	var col := SprintUiShared.column(UiTokens.SPACE_XS)
	row.add_child(col)
	var who := SprintUiShared.box(UiTokens.SPACE_M)
	who.add_child(UiFactory.make_glyph(SprintUiShared.BUILDING, UiTokens.D_ICON_MARK, UiTokens.D_INK_3))
	who.add_child(_name(String(r.customer), &"TipTitle", null))
	var chip: Control = _planned_chip(r) if planned else SprintUiShared.due_chip(String(r.due_text), r.soon)
	who.add_child(chip)
	col.add_child(who)
	var what := SprintUiShared.box(UiTokens.SPACE_M)
	what.add_child(HRUiShared.D_mono(String(r.mono), UiTokens.D_BOX_MONO, &"MonoMark"))
	what.add_child(_name(String(r.card_name), &"CaptionPrimary", null))
	col.add_child(what)
	HRUiShared.set_mouse_ignore(col)
	if planned:
		row.modulate = Color(Color.WHITE, UiTokens.D_PLANNED_ALPHA)
		# Tik ve tarih kendi ipucunu taşır: imleci alır, tıkı satıra geçirir.
		chip.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	row.tooltip_text = r.tip
	row.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	_hover(row, row.theme_type_variation, &"RequestRowHover")
	row.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
		if UiFactory.is_left_click(ev):
			request_picked.emit(r.module_id))
	return row


## Kartı bu sprintin planında olan talebin çipi: tik ve tarih, çerçevesiz; söz çipiyle aynı boyda.
func _planned_chip(r: Dictionary) -> HBoxContainer:
	var chip := SprintUiShared.box(UiTokens.SPACE_XS)
	chip.custom_minimum_size.y = UiTokens.D_H_TAG
	chip.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	chip.tooltip_text = tr("PRODUCT_REQUEST_PLANNED_TIP")
	chip.add_child(UiFactory.make_glyph(SprintUiShared.CHECK, UiTokens.D_ICON_TAG, UiTokens.D_ST_TEST))
	chip.add_child(SprintUiShared.label(String(r.due_text), &"CaptionName", UiTokens.D_INK_3))
	return chip


# --- Modüller ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Modül satırı: işaret, ad, "planda" (bu sprintte kartı varsa) ve şevron; açıksa altında adayları. Satırın başı tıklanınca açılır ya da
## kapanır.
func _module_row(m: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var open: bool = m.id == String(_model.ui.open_area)
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	row.theme_type_variation = &"ModuleRowOpen" if open else &"ModuleRow"
	var col := SprintUiShared.column(UiTokens.SPACE_L)
	row.add_child(col)
	var head := SprintUiShared.box(UiTokens.SPACE_M)
	head.custom_minimum_size.y = UiTokens.D_BOX_MONO
	head.add_child(HRUiShared.D_mono(String(m.mono), UiTokens.D_BOX_MONO, &"MonoMark"))
	head.add_child(_name(String(m.name), &"TipTitle", UiTokens.D_INK_2))
	if m.planned:
		head.add_child(SprintUiShared.label(tr("PRODUCT_IN_PLAN"), &"CaptionName", UiTokens.D_INK_1))
	head.add_child(UiFactory.make_glyph(CHEVRONS[int(open)], UiTokens.D_ICON_MARK, UiTokens.D_INK_4))
	HRUiShared.set_mouse_ignore(head)
	head.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	head.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	head.tooltip_text = String(m.name) + (SprintUiShared.SEP + tr("PRODUCT_IN_PLAN_TIP") if m.planned else "")
	head.gui_input.connect(func(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
		if UiFactory.is_left_click(ev):
			ui_changed.emit("open_area", "" if open else m.id))
	col.add_child(head)
	if open:
		_open_row = row

a=s.index('## "Söz kaçsın": söz bugünkü yoldan kırılır')
b=s.index('## B2C\'de yayından sonra ücretli plan önerinin ilk basamağındadır')
new='''## "Söz kaçsın": söz bugünkü yoldan kırılır, aynı zincirle (memnuniyet -20, güven izi -12, marka -3, tarih ve 8 hafta
## yeni söz yok). Çipteki memnuniyet kırığın kendi payıdır: anlık düşüş artı defterin darbesinin ve yükselen eşiğin hesabın
## hedefini kaydırdığı kadar; sürüklenme, defterin affı ve onboarding zemininin çekişi karışmaz. Zeminin dışındaki hesapta pay
## düşüş ile darbenin toplamıdır; oyuncu bir tik sonra düşüşü hâlâ okur. Sprint kapanışında kırılan söz için kâğıt süresi
## dolunca yeniden kırılmaz ve hata vermez. Onboarding zeminindeki hesapta (zemin = eşik + pay) eşik yükselir ve zemin onunla
## yükselir: pay, kırığın eşiği ne kadar yükselttiği kadar küçülür.
## FALSİFİKASYON: break_plan'da düşüşü (`PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT`) satisfaction_with_trust'a vermeyi bırak → ilk çip iddiası FAIL;
## çipi bir tik sonraki okumaya döndür → ilk çip iddiası FAIL; promise_break'te break_promise çağrısını sil → söz durumu FAIL;
## `broken.accounts.is_empty()` dönüşünü sil → süre dolumu iddiası FAIL; break_plan'ın verdiği yeni eşiği sil → onboarding çip
## iddiası FAIL.
static func _case_promise_break_chain() -> String:
	var w: Dictionary = _promise_world(1.1)
	if w.is_empty():
		return "fixture: the promise world's sprint did not start"
	var promise: Promise = w.promise
	var account: Customer = w.account
	_past_onboarding(account)
	_sim_day()
	if EventGate.active_id() != PROMISE_DUE:
		return "fixture: no promise card came"
	var sat: int = account.satisfaction
	var brand: int = GameState.brand
	var share: int = sat + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT + int(B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET)
	if share < 0 or B2BSalesSystem.satisfaction_target(account) + int(B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET) < 0:
		return "fixture: satisfaction %d or target %d too low for the break's share to stay unclamped" % [
			sat, B2BSalesSystem.satisfaction_target(account)]
	var plan: Dictionary = EvEffects.break_plan()
	var shown: Array = _promise_options().slip.chips
	if plan.accounts.size() != 1 or int(plan.accounts[0].from) != sat or int(plan.accounts[0].to) != share \\
			or shown.size() != 3 or not shown[0].contains("%d → %d" % [sat, share]) \\
			or not shown[2].contains(str(B2BConstants.PROMISE_RELOCK_WEEKS)):
		return "the slip option reads %s for a plan of %s, want the break's own share %d → %d" % [str(shown), str(plan), sat, share]
	var broken: Array = []
	var cb := func(id: String) -> void: broken.append(id)
	EventBus.promise_broken.connect(cb)
	EventGate.resolve(PROMISE_DUE, "slip")
	EventBus.promise_broken.disconnect(cb)
	if promise.status != "broken" or broken != [promise.id]:
		return "the word reads '%s' and promise_broken came %s" % [promise.status, str(broken)]
	if account.satisfaction != maxi(sat + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT, 0) \\
			or not is_equal_approx(account.trust_offset, B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET) \\
			or GameState.brand != brand + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_BRAND \\
			or account.promise_broken_day != GameState.day or not B2BSalesSystem.promise_relocked(account):
		return "the break left satisfaction %d (was %d), trust %s, brand %d (was %d), broken day %d, relocked %s" % [
			account.satisfaction, sat, account.trust_offset, GameState.brand, brand, account.promise_broken_day,
			B2BSalesSystem.promise_relocked(account)]
	if not EvEffects.run_expire([{"verb": "promise_break"}], {}, PROMISE_DUE).is_empty() or GameState.brand != brand + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_BRAND:
		return "the paper's expiry broke a word the sprint had already broken"
	GameState.advance_day()
	B2BSalesSystem.daily_tick()
	var held: float = move_toward(B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET, 0.0, TimeModel.per_tick(B2BConstants.TRUST_OFFSET_DECAY_PER_DAY))
	if not is_equal_approx(account.trust_offset, held) or account.satisfaction >= sat:
		return "a tick on the ledger holds %f (want %f) and the player reads %d → %d, want the dip" % [
			account.trust_offset, held, sat, account.satisfaction]
	w = _promise_world(1.1)
	if w.is_empty():
		return "fixture: the onboarding promise world's sprint did not start"
	account = w.account
	account.scale = 5
	account.tolerance = B2BConstants.seed_tolerance(account.scale, account.industry)
	account.acquired_on_day = GameState.day
	_sim_day()
	if EventGate.active_id() != PROMISE_DUE:
		return "fixture: no promise card came for the account inside its onboarding floor"
	var bar: int = account.tolerance
	var fit: int = ProductQuality.account_fit(account).value
	if fit >= bar + B2BConstants.ONBOARDING_GRACE_MARGIN or GameState.day + 1 >= B2BSalesSystem.onboarding_floor_until(account):
		return "fixture: the fit %d is not under the floor %d, or the floor lifts (day %d of %d) before the tick the chip reads" % [
			fit, bar + B2BConstants.ONBOARDING_GRACE_MARGIN, GameState.day, B2BSalesSystem.onboarding_floor_until(account)]
	sat = account.satisfaction
	plan = EvEffects.break_plan()
	EventGate.resolve(PROMISE_DUE, "slip")
	if account.tolerance <= bar:
		return "fixture: the break left the bar at %d (was %d)" % [account.tolerance, bar]
	share = clampi(sat + B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT + int(B2BConstants.PROMISE_BROKEN_OFFSET) + account.tolerance - bar, 0, 100)
	if int(plan.accounts[0].to) != share:
		return "inside the onboarding floor the chip reads %d → %d, want the break's own share %d (bar %d, was %d)" % [
			sat, plan.accounts[0].to, share, account.tolerance, bar]
	return ""


'''

print('ok')
